question:
Arrange the parts to form a correct sentence:
P: the CEO
Q: informed the team
R: during the meeting
S: about new policy changes
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (4)** i.e. **PQSR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence begins with part **P**, which introduces the subject "the CEO" in a grammatically logical manner.
 
• Following the subject, part **Q** continues the logical sequence, stating that the CEO "informed the team."
